result.title: Deep Pontryagin Learning for Continuous-Time Stochastic Control with Jumps
result.summary: We develop a deep Pontryagin learning framework for high-dimensional continuous-time stochastic control problems that naturally accommodates jump-diffusions. In contrast to direct policy optimization, which repeatedly differentiates the objective through the entire time-discretized dynamics, our method separates adjoint learning from policy improvement by explicitly incorporating state-sensitivity information from the Pontryagin stochastic maximum principle. For a fixed Markov control, we first compute pathwise adjoint labels by backpropagating the reward through time along simulated state trajectories, and project these labels onto the Markov state through a supervised regression step. The control is then updated by enforcing the pointwise Hamiltonian stationarity condition. We prove that the resulting projected adjoint process satisfies a discrete-time Pontryagin principle and converges, as the time step tends to zero, to the solution of the corresponding continuous-time adjoint backward stochastic differential equation. Numerical experiments illustrate the accuracy, stability, and scalability of the approach.

AI.brief_summary: 该论文提出深度 Pontryagin 学习框架，求解含跳扩散的高维连续时间随机控制：把伴随（状态敏感度）学习与策略改进分离，先用轨迹反向传播得到路径级伴随标签并回归投影到 Markov 状态，再以逐点 Hamiltonian 平稳条件更新控制。
